Asset.description:
One of an item's files: its original, or a derivative. `href` answers with a short-lived
link to the bytes (`GET /items/{id}/assets/{role}`).
Asset.title: Asset

AssetUrl.description: A link to one asset's bytes, read-only, and when it stops working.
AssetUrl.title: AssetUrl

Collection.description: A collection as returned by the API; built straight from `store.CollectionRow`.
Collection.title: Collection

Filters.description:
What a search or a footprint map asks for. Every filter given must hold for every item
shown (SRCH-1); a list filter that is empty matches nothing.
Filters.title: Filters

FootprintView.description:
TileJSON for a footprint view: its tile URL (relative to the API), and when it stops
serving. A map past that opens a new view.
FootprintView.title: FootprintView

ItemProperties.description:
Core fields plus whatever the header said (`proj:shape`, `raster:bands`, `pc:count`,
`mesh:triangles`, ...), which is why other keys are allowed.
ItemProperties.title: ItemProperties

NextLink.description:
STAC's link to the next page of a POST search: repeat the request with `body` merged
into it.
NextLink.title: NextLink

PreviewSession.description:
A preview of one raster item: the tiler's TileJSON for it, the token its requests carry
(as `Authorization: Bearer`), and when that token stops working. A map past that asks again.
PreviewSession.title: PreviewSession

Reason.description: Why the pipeline rejected a version. Quarantine's reason is the scanner's signature.
Reason.title: Reason

SearchIn.description: One page of a search: its filters, and where the page starts.
SearchIn.title: SearchIn

Upload.description: An upload as returned by the API; built straight from `store.UploadRow`.
Upload.title: Upload

UploadPage.description: The caller's own uploads, newest first.
UploadPage.title: UploadPage

UploadSession.description: An upload plus the signed URL its bytes go to. The URL is shown once and never stored.
UploadSession.title: UploadSession

schema.title: Response List Grants Collections  Collection Id  Grants Get

get.description: Public, non-secret settings for the SPA, so one web build runs against any IdP or cloud.

Redirects to an asset's bytes (`original`, or a derivative's role): a read-only link to
that one file, valid for at most 15 minutes.

404.description: No such item, or no such asset

get.description: The link `GET /items/{id}/assets/{role}` redirects to, as JSON, for clients that can't read a redirect: a browser's `fetch` hides it, and an `` can't send a token.

404.description: No such item, or no such asset

post.description:
Opens a preview of a raster item: a token for the tiler to serve its map tiles under, for
at most 15 minutes, and the tiler's TileJSON for it.

404.description: No such item, or no COG to preview it from

post.description:
One page of readable items matching every filter, newest first. Follow the `next` link,
merging its body into this request, for the following page.

Opens a view of the footprints of every readable item matching `body`, for a map to
draw as vector tiles, and returns its TileJSON.

get.description:
One tile of a footprint view the caller opened: their readable items matching its
filters, drawn in layer `footprints`. Not audited; opening the view was.

404.description: No live view of the caller's by this id

get.description:
One page of the caller's own uploads in collections they can still read, newest first.
Pass `next` back as `token` for the following page.

The caller's own uploads as they change, as server-sent `upload` events (each an
`Upload`): every upload being watched when the stream opens, then each again when it
changes. The stream ends after a few minutes; open another to carry on.

post.description: A new signed URL for an upload still in progress, for transfers that outlast one.
